subject: Request to pause demo timer while PO is reconciling
messages:
From: Eli Thompson <eli@mednova.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo access — procurement running behind, can we pause the timer?

Hi Neha,

Quick note from procurement: our PO is in a routing hold (security asked for an extra signature) and they said it might take 4–6 business days to clear. The team is mid-integration and the demo environment is ticking down.

Can Redwood either pause the trial timer or provide a short credit so we don’t lose progress? We can share the PO snapshot (attached) and a contact at procurement if that helps.

Appreciate any flexibility — we’re close to a purchasing decision and want to keep the engineers running.

Thanks,
Eli Thompson
VP of Engineering
MedNova

A: MedNova, 410 Market St

Subject: Re: Demo access — procurement running behind, can we pause the timer?

Hi Eli — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO snapshot. I’m looping in David (sales lead) and Camila (CS) to coordinate. I’ve also added Kimberly from finance so she can confirm the approval path.

A couple of quick asks so we can move faster on our side:
- Can procurement confirm an expected clearance date (approx)?
- PO number or reference for our billing team?

We typically do one of two things in cases like this:
1) Pause the demo timer for up to 7 days while PO clears (internal approval required), or
2) Grant a small token credit to preserve the integration work while procurement completes routing.

If you prefer, we can do both — pause the timer and apply a 3–5 day credit. I’ll check with finance for a final sign-off and come back with confirmation within the hour.

-Neha
